title: Teal Warrior Poses
description: Three sequential views of a teal-haired anime character against a plain gray background: standing in a dynamic pose with one arm raised, mid-air in a falling or knocked-back position, and lying flat on the ground defeated.
prompt: A teal-haired anime warrior with pale skin wearing a purple and teal outfit with a long flowing cape, black gloves and boots. Three separate poses on a neutral gray background: standing dynamically with one arm raised and cape flowing, falling backwards through the air with limbs outstretched, and lying flat on the ground with eyes closed. Clean digital painting style with cel-shading and soft shadows.
